name: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
description: Winter. Hawkins. 1985. Welcome back to a town crawling with secrets, where beloved heroes are facing fresh mysteries... and an all-new breed of strange.

videos.title: Chapter One: Welcome to Hawkins, New Kid
videos.overview: A surprising new threat alters the gang's plans to shovel snow for extra cash, bringing them face to face with danger and closer to a cool new student.

videos.title: Chapter Two: Bad Harvest
videos.overview: Nikki joins the party — and the newly formed Hawkins Investigators Club. Strange things take root at a nearby farm and shake up the Winter Festival.

videos.title: Chapter Three: Evolution
videos.overview: The kids look for answers about the mutant creatures plaguing their town and get a helpful lesson from Mrs. Baxter, their substitute science teacher.

videos.title: Chapter Four: The Confession
videos.overview: A worried Mike decides to come clean to Hopper, and Dustin drags Steve into the H.I.C. Nikki welcomes Will to the mosh pit. Lucas and Max hit the arcade.

videos.title: Chapter Five: The Weekly Watcher
videos.overview: When a photo that could put El in danger gets sold to a popular tabloid, the kids pull Nancy into a heist to get it back. If they can't? It's game over.

videos.title: Chapter Six: A Storm Is Coming
videos.overview: As a blizzard bears down on Hawkins, Dustin goes on a side quest, and Max and Lucas hear a cry for help. A bold move lands some of the gang in detention.

videos.title: Chapter Seven: Enter the Storm
videos.overview: Lucas and Max seek higher ground to call in a Code Red. Across town, Will, Mike and Nikki are snowed in at school — and El can see they're not alone.

videos.title: Chapter Eight: The Party
videos.overview: Dustin finds danger at the Food Mart when two terrifying creatures break in. The gang gears up to go underground just in time for Nikki's birthday.

videos.title: Chapter Nine: The Suspect
videos.overview: In the wake of a shocking revelation, the H.I.C. digs in to investigate, splitting up into teams to search for more clues and uncover the truth.

videos.title: Chapter Ten: Countdown
videos.overview: With time running out, the party pulls together for a brave battle to stay alive. Friends have to help friends — because Hawkins' future depends on it.
